targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY wo),
  agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                 COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
          FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.wo=s.wo) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(good+scrap,0)::numeric,2) AS value FROM agg
SELECT COALESCE(SUM("targetQty"),0) AS value FROM shift_instances t JOIN factories f ON f.id = t."factoryId" WHERE $__timeFilter(t."shiftDate") AND ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory')

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY wo),
  agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                 COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
          FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.wo=s.wo) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((LEAST(100,100.0*run/NULLIF(ppt,0)))*(LEAST(100,100.0*earned/NULLIF(run,0)))*(100.0*good/NULLIF(good+scrap,0))/10000,0)::numeric,2) AS value FROM agg
SELECT COALESCE(SUM("downtimeMinutes"),0) AS value FROM shift_instances t JOIN factories f ON f.id = t."factoryId" WHERE $__timeFilter(t."shiftDate") AND ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory')

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT $__timeGroup(t."bucketStart",$__interval) tg, t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq,
           t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb, t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT tg, wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY tg, wo) SELECT s.tg AS time, SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms)+SUM(s.sb) AS "Actual" FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.tg=s.tg AND f.wo=s.wo GROUP BY s.tg ORDER BY s.tg

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t."shiftDate",$__interval), SUM("targetQty") AS "Target" FROM shift_instances t JOIN factories f ON f.id = t."factoryId" WHERE $__timeFilter(t."shiftDate") AND ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH scoped AS (
        SELECT t."shiftInstanceId" sid, t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
               t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
        FROM production_snapshots t
        WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine') AND t."shiftInstanceId" IS NOT NULL),
      fin AS (SELECT sid, wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY sid, wo),
      agg AS (SELECT s.sid, COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                     COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
              FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.sid=s.sid AND f.wo=s.wo GROUP BY s.sid)
      SELECT st.name AS "Shift", si."shiftDate" AS "Date", ROUND((good+scrap)::numeric,0) AS "Actual",
             si."targetQty" AS "Target", ROUND(good::numeric,0) AS "Good", ROUND(scrap::numeric,0) AS "Scrap",
             ROUND(((LEAST(100,100.0*run/NULLIF(ppt,0)))*(LEAST(100,100.0*earned/NULLIF(run,0)))*(100.0*good/NULLIF(good+scrap,0))/10000)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %"
      FROM agg JOIN shift_instances si ON si.id=agg.sid JOIN shift_templates st ON st.id=si."shiftTemplateId"
      ORDER BY si."shiftDate" DESC LIMIT 50
